workspace.root.description: Absolute workspace root for the main BeiFeng-Agent project.

agent.version.description: Configuration version for the BeiFeng Agent workspace.

model.provider.description: Model provider family or compatibility mode.

model.name.description: Default model name used by scripts and agent launchers.

model.base_url.description: Model base URL or environment-variable placeholder such as ${DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL}.

model.api_key_env.description: Environment variable name that stores the model API key.

rag.service_url.description: Local RAG service URL used by the agent and evaluation scripts.

rag.db_path.description: SQLite database path for the RAG index, relative to workspace.root unless absolute.

paths.memory.description: Runtime memory directory for turbine profiles, history, and report memory.

paths.connectors.description: BeiFeng connector schema and documentation directory.

frontend.enabled.description: Whether the future desktop frontend is active.

safety.require_human_confirmation.description: Require human confirmation for safety-sensitive workflows.

safety.forbidden_actions.description: Actions the agent must not perform or recommend as autonomous operations.
